qemu.use: qemu-system-i386 with only the i386 target and no optional features; runs Windows 98 Setup from the user's ISO once

mtools.use: mformat, mcopy, mdel, mmd and mdir: the FAT disk and boot floppy of Setup

cabextract.use: extracts the boot files from the CAB archives of the user's ISO
